python-2.7.base:
FROM python:2.7-slim-buster
RUN apt-get install bash

python-3.7.base:
FROM python:3.7-slim-buster
RUN apt-get install bash

c/c++.base:
FROM frolvlad/alpine-gxx
RUN apk add bash
RUN apk add make
RUN apk add build-base
RUN apk add python3

java.base:
FROM openjdk:8-jdk-alpine
RUN apk add bash
RUN apk add make
RUN apk add build-base
RUN apk add python3

javascript.base:
FROM node:13.8.0-alpine3.10
RUN apk add bash
RUN apk add make
RUN apk add build-base
RUN apk add python3
javascript.useradd: RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S -G app app

haskell.base:
FROM haskell:8
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update --fix-missing {updateID}
RUN apt-get install bash

ocaml.base:
FROM ocaml/ocaml:latest
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get install bash

ruby.base:
FROM ruby:2.7-alpine
RUN apk add bash
RUN apk add make
RUN apk add build-base
RUN apk add python3

php.base:
FROM php:7.4-cli-alpine
RUN apk add bash
RUN apk add make
RUN apk add build-base
RUN apk add python3
php.useradd: RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S -G app app

alpine.base:
FROM alpine:3.11
RUN apk add bash
RUN apk add make
RUN apk add build-base
alpine.useradd: RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S -G app app

ubuntu.base:
FROM ubuntu:18.04
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update --fix-missing {updateID}
RUN apt-get install bash
